paragrafos: I'm a software designer in the age of AI. While generative models speed up coding, my role lies in what comes before it: envisioning, structuring, and planning solid systems, guided by Software Engineering best practices.
I believe every project is born from a human need that deserves to be explored, understood, and handled responsibly, since its impact reflects, in the long run, on both the individual and society.
As a developer, I'm committed to constantly evolving my solutions toward a more sustainable and humane future.

projetos.intro: My highlights, the projects I like most.

lista.linha: Gamified and accessible physical therapy in SaaS format.
lista.descricao: Remote monitoring platform that transforms home exercises into an interactive and measurable experience. It uses gamification to boost motivation, provides continuous feedback on technique and execution, allowing the physiotherapist to monitor the patient's recovery without it being interrupted when they leave the clinic.
